HILINFRA.NS.d: Highway Infrastructure Limited provides toll collection and wider infrastructure services across India. It has three divisions: Toll, Work Contract and Machinery Hire, and Real Estate. Its activities also include building roads and bridges and carrying out engineering, procurement and construction projects.

HINDCON.NS.d: Hindcon Chemicals Limited was established in 1947 in Kolkata as Hind Silicates Pvt Ltd. It makes and supplies sodium silicates, cement additives and construction chemicals to Indian and international customers, with products that include coating and impregnation solutions and concrete-related chemicals.

INDIANCARD.NS.d: The Indian Card Clothing Company Limited manufactures and sells card clothing products and accessories in India and internationally. It operates through Card Clothing and Real Estate segments. The company's products include cotton and synthetic products comprising cylinder wires, doffer wires, lickerin wires, and flat tops; metallic wires for non-woven cards; woolen, sundry, and fancy fillets; and rasing fillets and brush sheets for various fibres, yarn rasing fillets, humbugs, and hand cleaning cards.

ITC.NS.d: ITC Limited engages in the fast moving consumer goods, hotels, paperboards, paper and packaging, agri, and information technology (IT) businesses in India and internationally. The company primarily offers cigarettes and cigars; staples, spices, biscuits, confectionery and gums, snacks, noodles and pasta, beverages, dairy, ready to eat meals, chocolate, coffee, and frozen foods; personal care products; education and stationery products; safety matches; and incense sticks under various brands.

JAINSTUDIO.NS.d: Jain Studios Limited engages in the electronic media business in India. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in New Delhi, India.

KILITCH.NS.d: Kilitch Drugs (India) Limited engages in the development and operation of pharmaceutical business in India. The company offers parenteral and nasal products, including gastroenterology, anti-inflammatory, anticonvulsant/antiepileptic, anti-malarial, aminoglycoside, antibacterial, anti-hypertensive, anti-infective, diagnostic, sympathomimetic, local anesthetic, neurotonic, uterine stimulant, external preparation, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory, oncology, ophthalmic, and other drugs, as well as vaccines and…

KOHINOOR.NS.d: Kohinoor Foods Limited manufactures and sells food products under the Kohinoor and Monsoon brand names in India. It offers basmati rice and non-basmati rice; packaged food products, such as ready to eat food, ready to cook, frozen ready to eat food, dairy products, namkeen savories, ghee, paneer, ready mixes, sweets, biscuits and cookies, and dry fruits, as well as olive, rice brain, and canola oil products; cooking pastes, chutney's, spices, seasonings, frozen breads, snacks, and simmer sauces; organic lentils…

KPITTECH.NS.d: KPIT Technologies Limited, a technology company, provides engineering, embedded software, artificial intelligence, and digital solutions for automobile and mobility industries in the Americas, the United Kingdom, Europe, and internationally.

LTM.NS.d: LTM Limited provides technology consulting and digital transformation services in India, North America and Europe. It organizes its work around banking and insurance, technology and media, manufacturing, consumer markets, and health and public sector clients, with services in cloud, cybersecurity, digital engineering, enterprise applications, automation and data analytics.

MAWANASUG.NS.d: Mawana Sugars Limited manufactures and markets sugar under the Mawana brand in India. The company operates through Sugar, Power, Chemicals, and Distillery segments. It produces plantation white, refined, and specialty sugars, as well as IP grade sugar for pharmaceutical use. The company also offers chemical products, such as caustic soda, chlorine, stable bleaching powder, hydrogen, and hydrochloric acid.

MOLDTKPAC.NS.d: Mold-Tek Packaging Limited manufactures and sells plastic packaging containers in India. It provides sanitizer containers, dispensing pumps, food containers, paint packaging products, lubricant packs, and bulk packaging products. The company was formerly known as Moldtek Plastics Limited and changed its name to Mold-Tek Packaging Limited in March 2010. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

NUVOCO.NS.d: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited is an Indian maker and seller of building materials. It produces cement types including ordinary Portland, Portland Pozzolana, composite and slag cements under brands like Concreto, Duraguard and Double Bull, and sells ready-mix concrete under names such as Agile and Artiste. It also manufactures construction chemicals.

PINELABS.NS.d: Pine Labs Ltd. provides payment solutions and point-of-sale systems to merchants, aiming to digitize commerce. Its work spans digital payments and issuing for merchants, consumer brands, enterprises and financial institutions, with products like Plutus, the myPlutus app, analytics and PaybyPoints. Three founders, Rajul Garg, Lokvir Kapoor and Tarun Upaday, started it in May 1998, and it is headquartered in Noida.

RAIN.NS.d: Rain Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells carbon products, cement, electricity, and specialty chemicals in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Carbon, Advanced Materials, and Cement.

SALASAR.NS.d: Salasar Techno Engineering Limited manufactures and sells galvanized and non- galvanized steel structures in India and internationally. The company's products include telecommunication towers, power transmission line towers, smart lighting poles, monopoles, guard rails, substation structures, solar module mounting structures, and customized galvanized and non-galvanized steel structures.

SHANTIGOLD.NS.d: Shanti Gold International Limited, a Mumbai company set up in 2003, designs, makes and wholesales gold jewelry. Its catalog covers bangles, rings, necklaces, pendants and earrings, and its buyers are located across India, the US, Qatar, Singapore and the UAE.

SHRENIK.NS.d: Shrenik Limited engages in the trading and processing of paper, pulp, paperboards, etc. in Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra. It offers printing and writing papers, and other specialty papers; and coated paper, uncoated maplitho paper, copier paper, and duplex and folding box boards under the Shrenik Premium Copier Paper and Shrenik Premium Digital Paper brand names. Shrenik Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

SLONE.NS.d: Slone Infosystems Ltd. is an Indian company primarily engaged in providing IT hardware solutions, functioning as a system integrator for enterprise clients. The company's core business involves both the sale and rental of a diverse range of IT equipment, including laptops, desktops, servers, workstations, switches, CCTV systems, SAN storage, and computer peripherals, as well as offering software.

SPAL.NS.d: S.P. Apparels Limited manufactures and sells knitted garments for infants and children under the Natalia brand in India and internationally. The company manufactures and retails adult menswear, such as shirts, polo shirts, T-shirts, trousers, jeans, sweaters, jackets, vests, briefs, boxer shorts, and socks under the Crocodile brand. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Tirupur, India.

SRTRANSFIN-Z5.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 9.31% Sr.III represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 9.31% and belonging to Series III of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

SRTRANSFIN-ZC.NS.d: Sec Red NCD Sr.X represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, belonging to Series X of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

TASTYBITE.NS.d: Tasty Bite Eatables Limited manufactures and sells ready-to-eat food, and formed frozen food and specialty sauces under the Tasty Bite brand name in India and internationally. The company offers rice, Indian entrées, Asian noodles, patties, appetizers, ready meals, and gravies and pastes, as well as specialty, emulsion, and tomato based sauces; and ingredients, such as basmati rice, black lentils, brown rice, cardamom, cashew nuts, chickpeas, cloves, coconut milk, coriander, and cumin.

UTTAMSTL.NS.d: Uttam Galva Steels Limited manufactures and sells steel products in India. The company manufactures cold rolled steel; and galvanized products comprising galvanized plain, galvanized corrugated, and color coated products. It also offers cold rolled closed annealed coils, cut to length sheets, and full hard cold rolled steel.

VAIBHAVGBL.NS.d: Vaibhav Global Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, retails, trades in, and exports fashion jewelry, accessories, lifestyle, and essential products. The company offers colored gems stones, precious and semi-precious stones, bracelets, bangles, earrings, studded jewelry, etc.; fashion accessories, such as scarves, handbags, etc.; and lifestyle products comprising home decor and kitchen products.

VINSYS.NS.d: Vinsys IT Services India Ltd. operates as a global provider of IT services and professional training and development. The company's primary offerings include corporate training and certifications in areas such as project management, IT security, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud computing, and application development. It also provides digital learning solutions, including learning management systems and custom content development.

VITAL.NS.d: Vital Chemtech Ltd. makes and supplies phosphorus-based chemicals in India and internationally, including phosphorus pentasulfide, orthophosphoric and polyphosphoric acid, and the trichloride, oxychloride, pentachloride and pentoxide of phosphorus. It also supplies industrial chemicals like sodium benzoate and acetyl chloride.

VR.NS.d: V R Infraspace Ltd. is an Indian construction and real estate development company. It primarily focuses on the development of residential and commercial projects, including shopping malls, in and around Vadodara, Gujarat. The company aims to provide properties with modern designs and functional, user-friendly features, catering to residential and commercial real estate needs.
